crs_attributes.CameraProfile: PENTAX K-3 II 1376 Composed Tone Offline v1

same_engine.lcms: Little CMS ICC profile applier for TIFF - v6.3 [LittleCMS 2.12]

sdk_order.scope: Fixed same-engine chart diagnostics. No fit or inference of Lightroom internals.

output_space_plan.scope: Same #1376 source and two frozen DCPs, two export spaces, no fit or new profile
output_space_plan.controls: 115 exact CRS attributes and 6 exact nested elements per role, As Shot 5200/+2, EV0, PV15.4, Camera Raw 19.0, Lightroom Classic 16.0, full-size SDR Adobe RGB uncompressed 16-bit RGB TIFF, no resize/output sharpening, all metadata.
output_space_plan.registration: 19 sites per role, search radius 8px, correlation >0.85 and shift <1px, no resampling.
output_space_plan.mask_rule: Fixed intersection over both pinned ProPhoto roles, based only on the installed Adobe RGB matrix/TRCs and exact embedded ProPhoto matrix/TRCs. Unclipped predicted Adobe RGB linear R/G/B must be strictly inside (0.01, 0.99). Never remove points based on actual Adobe RGB.
output_space_plan.measurement: Direct matrix/TRC, LittleCMS relative-colorimetric RGB16 without BPC -c0, and -c1 sensitivity. Measure actual versus all three predictions in Adobe RGB codes and PCS D50 Lab. Back-transform actual to equivalent ProPhoto linear RGB, compare with native ProPhoto code-equivalent and linears, score both fixed extrema witness pairs and orange hue ratio on the exact masks and rank restrictions. No tolerance-based private pipeline equivalence.

historical_qualification.strict_icc_initial_result: rejected before color metrics, due to embedded vs installed whole-byte ICC SHA mismatch
historical_qualification.strict_icc_failure_condition: embedded Adobe RGB SHA-256 must equal installed ICC SHA-256
historical_qualification.amendment: accept only pinned installed and embedded ICC bytes with verified date and copyright differences, and require exact all-ROI LittleCMS predictions from both profiles in -c0 and -c1
historical_qualification.sdk_lut_precision: float32 source ordinates and sampled tables with float64 interpolation in Python; SDK reference tone interpolation and ACR3 evaluation use real32 arithmetic
